Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Redwood coverage: SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected audit completion Q1 2027); we have available evidence for security controls through our security portal today.
- GDPR posture: we provide a standard DPA and support SCCs; we typically recommend Module 2 (Controller/Processor) with an Annex for subprocessors, but will adapt based on your counsel.
- For Acme specifically, we need confirmation on the relationship: is Acme acting strictly as a controller (you control the customer data flows) with Redwood as processor, or will there be any joint-controller scenarios?

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm controller/processor role for Acme (one-line will do).
2) I attached our draft DPA and the SCC Annex Module 2 (see attachments). If your legal team prefers Module 1 vs Module 2 we can switch — we just need to know which SCC module to include.
3) Please have your security/contact (cc'd) fill the Vendor Security Questionnaire attached (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) and return by COB Thu, Oct 15.

I attached: Redwood_DPA_Draft_20261012.pdf, SCC_Annex_Module_2_v1.docx, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx.

If helpful I can loop Rishi from our legal/compliance to review any redlines with your counsel — CC'ing him here.

Thanks,

— Marissa
